notes.claim: If two numbers multiply to zero, at least one of them is zero: if ab = 0 then a = 0 and/or b = 0.

sources.title: Quadratic equations - Solving quadratic equations - Edexcel - GCSE Maths Revision - Edexcel - BBC Bitesize
sources.quote: If the product of two numbers is zero then one or both of the numbers must also be equal to zero. Therefore if ab = 0, then a = 0 and/or b = 0
